name: micro-saas-scout
description: Discover SaaS opportunities on any website using AI.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w dashboard && npm run build -w extension && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:dashboard: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w dashboard
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w extension
scripts.package:extension: mkdir -p deploy/chrome && rm -f deploy/chrome/micro-saas-scout-extension.zip && npm run build:extension:production && cd extension/dist && zip -r ../../deploy/chrome/micro-saas-scout-extension.zip .
scripts.deploy:prepare: npm run generate:assets && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:server && npm run package:extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w dashboard && npm run typecheck -w extension && npm run typecheck -w server
